# Purpose

This notebook performs targeted QC sensitivity analyses for the 2022 yarn results.

It focuses on the three primary traits whose mixed models were singular:

- normalized skein strength (`skein_mn_tex`);
- single-end tenacity (`yarn_tenacity_cn_tex`);
- thin places at -50% (`yarn_thin_50`).

For these traits, the NIL-pair random-effect variance collapsed to approximately
zero in the primary model. A simplified fixed-effects model is therefore fitted as
a sensitivity analysis:

`trait ~ background * qtl_status + field_rep`

The notebook also checks whether the single-end tenacity result is sensitive to the
one > |3 SD| residual observation (`AC164Pos` in the original diagnostic output).

The primary mixed-model results remain the main analysis. These simplified models
are used only to verify that the biological interpretation is not an artifact of a
zero-variance random effect or one influential observation.

# 1. Check required packages

```{r check-packages}
required_packages <- c(
  "dplyr",
  "readr",
  "tibble",
  "purrr",
  "emmeans",
  "car"
)

missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !vapply(
    required_packages,
    requireNamespace,
    logical(1),
    quietly = TRUE
  )
]

if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Install the following packages before continuing: ",
    paste(
      missing_packages,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}
```

# 2. Locate cleaned sample-level yarn data

```{r locate-input-data}
sample_file <- file.path(
  paths$data_processed,
  "yarn_2022_sample_level_clean.csv"
)

if (!file.exists(sample_file)) {
  stop(
    "Could not find cleaned yarn sample-level data:\n",
    sample_file
  )
}

yarn_sample <- readr::read_csv(
  sample_file,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
```

# 3. Prepare formal NIIL analysis population

```{r prepare-formal-data}
yarn_formal <- yarn_sample |>
  dplyr::filter(
    material_type == "NIIL",
    qtl_status %in% c(
      "Negative",
      "Positive"
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    background =
      factor(
        background,
        levels = c(
          "Acala",
          "Deltapine",
          "Georgia",
          "Paymaster"
        )
      ),
    qtl_status =
      factor(
        qtl_status,
        levels = c(
          "Negative",
          "Positive"
        )
      ),
    field_rep =
      factor(
        field_rep_inferred
      ),
    pair_id =
      interaction(
        background,
        nil_set,
        drop = TRUE
      )
  ) |>
  droplevels()

formal_audit <- tibble::tibble(
  check = c(
    "Formal NIIL samples",
    "Unique genotypes",
    "Unique NIL pairs"
  ),
  result = c(
    nrow(yarn_formal),
    dplyr::n_distinct(yarn_formal$genotype),
    dplyr::n_distinct(yarn_formal$pair_id)
  )
)

formal_audit
```

# 4. Define singular traits

```{r define-singular-traits}
singular_traits <- c(
  "skein_mn_tex",
  "yarn_tenacity_cn_tex",
  "yarn_thin_50"
)

trait_labels <- c(
  skein_mn_tex =
    "Normalized skein strength (mN/tex)",
  yarn_tenacity_cn_tex =
    "Single-end tenacity (cN/tex)",
  yarn_thin_50 =
    "Thin places (-50%)"
)
```

# 5. Fit simplified fixed-effects models

```{r fit-simplified-models}
fit_simplified_model <- function(trait) {

  model_data <- yarn_formal |>
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(
        .data[[trait]]
      )
    ) |>
    droplevels()

  formula_object <- stats::as.formula(
    paste0(
      trait,
      " ~ background * qtl_status + field_rep"
    )
  )

  fit <- tryCatch(
    stats::lm(
      formula_object,
      data = model_data
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      e
    }
  )

  list(
    trait = trait,
    n = nrow(model_data),
    model = fit
  )
}

simplified_results <- purrr::map(
  singular_traits,
  fit_simplified_model
)

names(simplified_results) <- singular_traits
```

# 6. Model status

```{r simplified-model-status}
simplified_model_status <- purrr::map_dfr(
  simplified_results,
  function(result) {

    if (inherits(result$model, "error")) {
      return(
        tibble::tibble(
          trait = result$trait,
          n = result$n,
          fitted = FALSE,
          message = conditionMessage(result$model)
        )
      )
    }

    tibble::tibble(
      trait = result$trait,
      n = result$n,
      fitted = TRUE,
      message = NA_character_
    )
  }
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    trait_label =
      unname(
        trait_labels[trait]
      )
  )

simplified_model_status
```

# 7. Type III tests

```{r simplified-type3}
extract_lm_type3 <- function(result) {

  if (inherits(result$model, "error")) {
    return(tibble::tibble())
  }

  a <- car::Anova(
    result$model,
    type = 3
  )

  out <- as.data.frame(a) |>
    tibble::rownames_to_column("effect") |>
    janitor::clean_names()

  tibble::tibble(
    trait = result$trait,
    effect = out$effect,
    df = out$df,
    f_value = out$f_value,
    p_value = out$pr_f
  )
}

simplified_type3 <- purrr::map_dfr(
  simplified_results,
  extract_lm_type3
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    trait_label =
      unname(
        trait_labels[trait]
      )
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(effect) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    fdr_p =
      stats::p.adjust(
        p_value,
        method = "BH"
      )
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()

simplified_type3
```

# 8. Overall QTL contrasts

```{r simplified-overall-qtl-contrasts}
extract_lm_qtl_contrast <- function(result) {

  if (inherits(result$model, "error")) {
    return(tibble::tibble())
  }

  em <- emmeans::emmeans(
    result$model,
    ~ qtl_status
  )

  contrast_result <- emmeans::contrast(
    em,
    method = list(
      "Positive - Negative" =
        c(
          -1,
          1
        )
    ),
    adjust = "none"
  )

  as.data.frame(
    contrast_result
  ) |>
    janitor::clean_names() |>
    tibble::as_tibble() |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      trait = result$trait,
      .before = 1
    )
}

simplified_qtl_contrasts <- purrr::map_dfr(
  simplified_results,
  extract_lm_qtl_contrast
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    trait_label =
      unname(
        trait_labels[trait]
      ),
    fdr_p =
      stats::p.adjust(
        p_value,
        method = "BH"
      )
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(
    fdr_p,
    p_value
  )

simplified_qtl_contrasts
```

# 9. Background-specific contrasts

```{r simplified-background-qtl-contrasts}
extract_lm_background_contrasts <- function(result) {

  if (inherits(result$model, "error")) {
    return(tibble::tibble())
  }

  em <- emmeans::emmeans(
    result$model,
    ~ qtl_status | background
  )

  contrast_result <- emmeans::contrast(
    em,
    method = list(
      "Positive - Negative" =
        c(
          -1,
          1
        )
    ),
    by = "background",
    adjust = "none"
  )

  as.data.frame(
    contrast_result
  ) |>
    janitor::clean_names() |>
    tibble::as_tibble() |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      trait = result$trait,
      .before = 1
    )
}

simplified_background_qtl <- purrr::map_dfr(
  simplified_results,
  extract_lm_background_contrasts
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    trait_label =
      unname(
        trait_labels[trait]
      )
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(background) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    fdr_p =
      stats::p.adjust(
        p_value,
        method = "BH"
      )
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()

simplified_background_qtl
```

# 10. Tenacity-specific influential-observation sensitivity

The original primary diagnostic flagged `AC164Pos` for tenacity with a standardized
residual greater than 3. This analysis excludes only that single observation.

```{r tenacity-outlier-sensitivity}
tenacity_flagged_genotype <- "AC164Pos"

tenacity_data_no_flag <- yarn_formal |>
  dplyr::filter(
    genotype != tenacity_flagged_genotype,
    !is.na(yarn_tenacity_cn_tex)
  ) |>
  droplevels()

tenacity_no_flag_model <- stats::lm(
  yarn_tenacity_cn_tex ~
    background * qtl_status +
    field_rep,
  data = tenacity_data_no_flag
)

tenacity_no_flag_type3 <- car::Anova(
  tenacity_no_flag_model,
  type = 3
) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("effect") |>
  janitor::clean_names()

tenacity_no_flag_emm <- emmeans::emmeans(
  tenacity_no_flag_model,
  ~ qtl_status
)

tenacity_no_flag_contrast <- emmeans::contrast(
  tenacity_no_flag_emm,
  method = list(
    "Positive - Negative" =
      c(
        -1,
        1
      )
  ),
  adjust = "none"
) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  tibble::as_tibble()

tenacity_no_flag_contrast
```

# 11. Tenacity sensitivity with actual yarn count

This model tests whether the simplified tenacity effect persists after adjusting
for actual yarn count.

```{r tenacity-count-adjusted-sensitivity}
tenacity_count_model <- stats::lm(
  yarn_tenacity_cn_tex ~
    background * qtl_status +
    field_rep +
    actual_yarn_count_ne,
  data = yarn_formal
)

tenacity_count_type3 <- car::Anova(
  tenacity_count_model,
  type = 3
) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("effect") |>
  janitor::clean_names()

tenacity_count_emm <- emmeans::emmeans(
  tenacity_count_model,
  ~ qtl_status
)

tenacity_count_contrast <- emmeans::contrast(
  tenacity_count_emm,
  method = list(
    "Positive - Negative" =
      c(
        -1,
        1
      )
  ),
  adjust = "none"
) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  tibble::as_tibble()

tenacity_count_contrast
```

tenacity_primary_simplified <- simplified_qtl_contrasts |>

# 14. Residual diagnostics for simplified singular models

```{r simplified-residual-diagnostics}
extract_lm_residuals <- function(result) {

  if (inherits(result$model, "error")) {
    return(tibble::tibble())
  }

  model_frame <- stats::model.frame(
    result$model
  )

  row_ids <- as.integer(
    rownames(
      model_frame
    )
  )

  d <- yarn_formal[
    row_ids,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  residual_values <- stats::residuals(
    result$model
  )

  residual_sd <- stats::sd(
    residual_values,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  d |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      trait = result$trait,
      field_sample_id,
      genotype,
      background,
      qtl_status,
      value =
        .data[[result$trait]],
      fitted =
        stats::fitted(
          result$model
        ),
      residual =
        residual_values,
      standardized_residual =
        residual_values /
        residual_sd
    )
}

simplified_residuals <- purrr::map_dfr(
  simplified_results,
  extract_lm_residuals
)

simplified_outliers <- simplified_residuals |>
  dplyr::filter(
    abs(
      standardized_residual
    ) > 3
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(
    trait,
    dplyr::desc(
      abs(
        standardized_residual
      )
    )
  )

simplified_outliers
```
